column1: # GEN decision statistics test vectors v2 (aien-spark/omega#476). Generated by tools/gen/protocol/genstats.c
# (`genstats vectors`); never edit by hand. Rules: docs/one_layer/GEN_PROTOCOL_V1.md sections 9 and 10.
# and its 6-decimal receipt values must equal these rounded to 6 decimals. Counts, p_num, p_den, yes/no and verdicts exactly.
# One record per line, TAB-separated; field 1 names the record kind; each kind has a #cols line.
# Verdict order: INVALID (validity, A - B > 2) > INCONCLUSIVE floor (max succ <= 3) / ceiling (min succ >= n - 3) > PASS > FAIL
# (D-C newcombe95_hi < 0.10, compared on the full double) > INCONCLUSIVE. v2 = v1 + the floor/ceiling rule and the length-match records (review of PR #486).
